perspectives.withheld: Unsure or prefer not to say

core_questions.text: Before today, had you heard about drones being used to transport goods or healthcare materials?
core_questions.organisation_text: Before today, had you personally heard about drones being used to transport goods or healthcare materials?

core_questions.text: In your own words, what do you currently know about these uses and their possible effects?
core_questions.organisation_text: In your own words, what do you currently know about these uses and their possible effects? Distinguish your own understanding from organisational activity you know about.

core_questions.text: Before this session, have you had any direct experience, learning or involvement related to these uses? If yes, briefly describe what you did.
core_questions.organisation_text: Before this session, have you had any direct experience, learning or involvement related to these uses? Describe what you did, or an organisational activity you know about, and say which you mean.
core_questions.when_exposure_already_reported: You mentioned an earlier activity. What did you do or contribute during it, if anything?

core_questions.text: What would you like to understand better, or what would help you take part in discussions or decisions about these uses?
core_questions.organisation_text: What would you like to understand better, or what support would help you or the organisation you represent take part in discussions or decisions about these uses? Say which you mean.
core_questions.when_information_already_reported: What would help you take part in discussions or decisions about these uses, if anything?
core_questions.when_opportunity_already_reported: What would you like to understand better about these uses, if anything?

probes.text: Are these statements about the same activity and period, or different experiences? You can say if you are unsure.
Can you explain why that effect might occur?
What did you do or contribute during that activity, if anything?
Were those experiences about drones or another service?
Do you know whether anything changed following your contribution?

dimensions.participation: Discussions and activities you took part in
dimensions.opportunity: Ways to take part and what makes it difficult

numerical_policy.reason: Numerical criteria and aggregation awaiting methodological approval.
